newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin's condition improves in hospital-Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin's condition improves in hospital-Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, being treated in hospital for pneumonia, is feeling much better and his temperature and blood pressure are normal, the Kremlin said.

"His condition has improved considerably, he is more physically active," the presidential press service said in a statement after doctors examined Yeltsin at Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital, where he was taken last Wednesday.
"There is only sporadic wheeziness in his lungs," it said.

Yeltsin, 65, met the Kremlin chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais in hospital for 40 minutes on Tuesday. It was his first known meeting with anyone except his family and doctors since he was taken to the hospital.
Yeltsin fell ill only two weeks after he returned to work in the Kremlin for the first time since his heart surgery on November 5. Doctors have said the latest illness is not linked to the operation.
The doctors have not set a date for the president to leave hospital.
